type: globe, single seat, cage guided, linear trim

installation.reducers: concentric DN80 x DN50 upstream and downstream
installation.pressure_taps: on the DN80 pipe, 2 D upstream and 6 D downstream of the reducers

flowmeter.kind: electromagnetic, in the DN80 loop upstream of the test section

p1_transmitter: gauge pressure, on a water-filled impulse line from the upstream tap
dp_transmitter: differential, on water-filled impulse lines from both taps

daq.procedure: pump off, holds of 75-110 s per point, pump off
